schemes.webex-oauth.description: "Webex OAuth access token. Each operation lists the scopes it accepts: any one entry in its `security` list is enough, and every scope inside an entry is required."

schemes.webex-oauth.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["spark-compliance:messages_read"]: "Read messages in your user's organization. The token's user must have the Compliance Officer role. Not included in spark:all."

schemes.webex-oauth.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["spark-compliance:messages_write"]: "Delete messages in all spaces in your user's organization. The token's user must have the Compliance Officer role. Not included in spark:all."

schemes.webex-oauth.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["spark-compliance:rooms_read"]: "Read rooms in your user's organization. The token's user must have the Compliance Officer role. Not included in spark:all."

schemes.webex-oauth.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["spark-compliance:rooms_write"]: "Modify rooms in your user's organization. The token's user must have the Compliance Officer role. Not included in spark:all."
schemes.webex-oauth.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["spark:all"]: "Full access to your Webex account. Doesn't include the spark-compliance scopes."
schemes.webex-oauth.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["spark:messages_read"]: "Read the content of rooms that you are in."
schemes.webex-oauth.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["spark:messages_write"]: "Post and delete messages on your behalf."
schemes.webex-oauth.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["spark:rooms_read"]: "List the titles of rooms that you are in."
